detailed_descriptions.en: UNHUMAN is a 2D idle extraction shooter set in a cyberpunk dystopia. Deploy into hostile zones and watch your character automatically navigate, loot, and fight. Extract before you die, or lose it all. CORE GAMEPLAY Deploy into raids where your character automatically navigates between loot locations. Search containers, hack terminals, pick locks - each location offers different rewards. Click on any location to direct your character where to go next. COMBAT Weapons have heat, jams, and recoil - your gear matters. Each weapon type plays differently: SMGs spray fast, Shotguns slide and blast, Bolt Actions hit hard but slow. Unlock gameplay-changing keystones like Chop Chop (hook and pull enemies), Bull Rush (charge and stun), or Degenerate Gambler (throw bottles, fight with fists). LOADOUT & STASH Equip your gear, pack items into your backpack for the raid, and manage your stash. SKILL TREE A massive skill tree with hundreds of nodes, 5 distinct classes, and gameplay-changing keystones. Create unique builds and theorycraft in plan mode. TECH TERMINAL Chips define your weapon's true potential. Use the Tech Terminal to upgrade your gear: Module items from raids let you craft random affixes. Codes let you choose exactly which affix to apply. Set up a Mining Rig to earn passive BTC - and occasionally discover rare codes while mining. AUGMENTS & COMPANION Install and upgrade cybernetic augments to unlock abilities like Scan and gain massive stat boosts. Your dog companion detects enemies before they ambush you and fetches extra loot during raids. INSANITY MINIGAME A corrupted arcade buried inside your terminal. Click your way through the static and farm Insanity , the currency behind mythic power: Battle endless waves and bosses . The deeper you go, the more Insanity you claim. Rebirth to multiply your damage and health, then push even further. Spend your earnings on boosts, permanent upgrades, and auto-clickers that grind for you. Crack open caches for rare rewards when the reels line up. TRADERS Five traders, each with their own specialty. Complete quests to build reputation - unlock discounts, better bargain prices, and coin flip for better rates.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
UNHUMAN is a 2D idle extraction shooter set in a cyberpunk dystopia. Deploy into hostile zones and watch your character automatically navigate, loot, and fight. Extract before you die, or lose it all.

CORE GAMEPLAY

Deploy into raids where your character automatically navigates between loot locations. Search containers, hack terminals, pick locks - each location offers different rewards. Click on any location to direct your character where to go next.

COMBAT

  • Weapons have heat, jams, and recoil - your gear matters. Each weapon type plays differently: SMGs spray fast, Shotguns slide and blast, Bolt Actions hit hard but slow.

  • Unlock gameplay-changing keystones like Chop Chop (hook and pull enemies), Bull Rush (charge and stun), or Degenerate Gambler (throw bottles, fight with fists).

LOADOUT & STASH

Equip your gear, pack items into your backpack for the raid, and manage your stash.

SKILL TREE

A massive skill tree with hundreds of nodes, 5 distinct classes, and gameplay-changing keystones. Create unique builds and theorycraft in plan mode.

TECH TERMINAL

Chips define your weapon's true potential. Use the Tech Terminal to upgrade your gear:

  • Module items from raids let you craft random affixes.

  • Codes let you choose exactly which affix to apply. 

  • Set up a Mining Rig to earn passive BTC - and occasionally discover rare codes while mining.

AUGMENTS & COMPANION

  • Install and upgrade cybernetic augments to unlock abilities like Scan and gain massive stat boosts.

  • Your dog companion detects enemies before they ambush you and fetches extra loot during raids.

INSANITY MINIGAME

A corrupted arcade buried inside your terminal. Click your way through the static and farm Insanity, the currency behind mythic power:

  • Battle endless waves and bosses. The deeper you go, the more Insanity you claim.

  • Rebirth to multiply your damage and health, then push even further.

  • Spend your earnings on boosts, permanent upgrades, and auto-clickers that grind for you.

  • Crack open caches for rare rewards when the reels line up.

TRADERS

Five traders, each with their own specialty. Complete quests to build reputation - unlock discounts, better bargain prices, and coin flip for better rates.
